messages.subject: Mapping users of Rattle
parts:
G'day,

Graham and I are interested in mapping all the different countries
that Rattle is used in, on a map of the world. We were wondering if
people could please tell us which country you use Rattle in, or what
countries you know that Rattle is used in.

To save the list getting flooded, you could send this information to
me at to...@g3n1u5.com

Thanks
Tony .
